text: Walk with me. Feel how the forest changes around you with every step.
The air grows lighter, not brighter exactly, but less heavy,
as if the world itself were exhaling.
You are in the crossing now, the narrow country between densities,
the veil that wrapped your whole life is thinning.
It does not tear all at once. It dissolves the way morning mist dissolves,
slowly, then all at once, and then you wonder how you ever mistook the mist for the world.
Here is a secret your body has kept from you.
You have been carrying two bodies all along.
The old one, built for forgetting, heavy and chemical,
made for a world of shadows, and within it, quietly growing, a lighter one,
a body of light, waiting for a world that runs on light.
The butterfly has been growing inside the cocoon the entire time.
You do not need to understand what is happening.
Nobody understands a metamorphosis while it is happening.
You only need to keep walking. The forest already knows the way.
